other_conditions: Applicant must be an innovative startup industrial activity or a new individual applicant.
Applicant must be a new MSME unit in Assam.
Priority is given to applicants who have undergone any skill development training.
Applicant must not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution.
benefits_summary: Provides a loan up to Rs 10 lakh with a 5 % interest subvention.
